description: Prepare a v2 addLiquidity through Aerodrome's Router with exact approvals and allowance cleanup. The read bundle quotes the actual split and resolves the pool, so a pair with no pool is caught before a deposit sets its price. LP tokens earn no AERO until staked with prepare_aerodrome_gauge_deposit.

amount_a_desired.description: Maximum token_a base units (positive decimal integer)

amount_a_min.description: Slippage bound: minimum token_a base units consumed (positive decimal integer)

amount_b_desired.description: Maximum token_b base units (positive decimal integer)

amount_b_min.description: Minimum token_b base units consumed (positive decimal integer)

deadline.description: Near-term unix timestamp; a past one makes the plan revert (positive decimal integer)

stable.description: Stable (true) or volatile pool; with the pair it identifies the pool

name: prepare_aerodrome_liquidity_deposit
title: Prepare an Aerodrome v2 liquidity deposit
